description: A SQL injection vulnerability affects an administrative API in HCL Commerce versions 8, 9.0.1 and 9.1.0 - 9.1.21. A remote attacker with an administrative role could use a crafted URL to infer unauthorized data from the database.

An XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability affects a Storefront REST API in HCL Commerce versions 8, 9.0.1 and 9.1.x. A remote attacker, using a specially crafted XML, could potentially view internal files or consume memory resources.
